context: Among policy analysts and regional teaching unions alike, it is widely held that sustained investment in early childhood literacy produces far higher social returns than remedial university programmes. decoys.whyVi: Chỉ kỹ năng đọc viết sớm, không diễn đạt quan điểm phổ biến.

context: Hydrologists surveying mountain glacier basins report that seasonal meltwater now peaks nearly three weeks earlier as a consequence of warming temperatures across northern latitudes. decoys.whyVi: Chỉ lưu vực sông băng, không phải cụm chỉ nguyên nhân.

context: Inside unused library basements across three industrial towns, retired master carpenters teach young residents how to repair damaged furniture free of charge. decoys.whyVi: Chỉ thợ mộc lão luyện đã nghỉ hưu, là người hướng dẫn.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (chủ động → bị động): "local councils fund the workshops" ↔ "the workshops are financed by municipal authorities".

context: Rural health directors managed to shorten outpatient clinic queues by nearly a quarter despite tight budgetary constraints across the regional health service. Introducing simplified electronic triage forms allowed senior nurses to handle routine prescription renewals directly, freeing doctors to concentrate on complex diagnostic consultations.

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ hàng chờ khám ngoại trú, không phải cụm nhượng bộ.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (mệnh đề although → cụm despite): "although hospital funding was limited" ↔ "despite tight budgetary constraints".

context: Telecommunications audits conducted in hilly farming villages indicate that ageing network capacity built on legacy copper cables repeatedly falls short of rising consumer requirements during evening video streaming and remote medical appointments. context: Reviewing five years of anonymous exit interview transcripts across logistics firms revealed that unpredictable shift scheduling, rather than annual salary benchmarks, was the primary driver behind employee turnover. decoys.whyVi: Chỉ khung lương hàng năm, thường bị hiểu nhầm là lý do duy nhất.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (mệnh đề quan hệ why → cụm danh từ driver behind): "the reason why staff resign" ↔ "the primary driver behind employee turnover".

context: Water utility planners evaluating drought-resilience budgets point out that pumping desalinated coastal water inland carries a considerably higher cost than fixing leaks through routine municipal pipe repairs. decoys.whyVi: Chỉ nước biển khử mặn, là đối tượng so sánh.

questionPhrase: cities that invest in cycling lanes

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ dải phân cách liên tục, là chi tiết kỹ thuật hạ tầng.

context: Although modern mass spectrometers have dramatically sharpened atmospheric measurements, our basic understanding of trapped air bubbles inside polar ice core samples dates back to findings from the 1960s. questionPhrase: residents are not allowed to build
context: Under updated catchment zoning ordinances designed to protect seasonal floodwater channels, homeowners are barred from constructing permanent extensions across low-lying historic riverside meadows. Chỉ quy định trang phục tối thoải mái, là biện pháp thu hút.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (rarely + V → seldom + V + N): "rarely attracts younger audiences" ↔ "seldom draws interest from under-thirties".

context: Media ethics instructors warn that reprinting claims straight from corporate press releases misleads busy readers without independent statistical verification by reporters. decoys.whyVi: Chỉ thông cáo báo chí doanh nghiệp, là nguồn dễ thiên lệch.

context: Police precinct audits across suburban housing blocks documented that residential break-ins declined following the coordinated installation of motion-activated porch lamps and reinforced window latches. Neighbourhood watch groups also noted that trimmed front hedges eliminated dark hiding spots along pedestrian alleyways near bus stops.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (fewer + N + occurred after → N + declined following): "fewer burglaries occurred after" ↔ "break-ins declined following".

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ điểm vốn từ biểu đạt, là kết quả ở trẻ.

questionPhrase: so that local inns benefit directly
context: Regional tourism boards along rocky coastlines are promoting multi-day walking trails in order to channel spending directly to family guesthouses and village bakeries. decoys.whyVi: Chỉ tàu du lịch trọn gói, là mô hình giữ tiền bên ngoài địa phương.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (mệnh đề so that → cụm in order to + V): "so that local inns benefit directly" ↔ "in order to channel spending directly to family guesthouses".

questionPhrase: was originally designed as a market

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ vòm mái gang đúc, là chi tiết kiến trúc.

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ chiến thuật phân phối tốc độ thi đấu, là kỹ năng nổi bật.

questionPhrase: has led to a sharp drop in

context: Consumer decision trials conducted in university labs indicate that as the range of product options expands beyond a dozen variants, shoppers often delay buying altogether and report stronger post-purchase regret. decoys.whyVi: Chỉ sự hối tiếc sau khi mua hàng, là hệ quả tâm lý.

questionPhrase: provided that battery weight stays low

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ nhiệt thải công nghiệp, là nguồn năng lượng tận dụng.

context: In undergraduate history modules built around seminar debate sessions, learners are prompted to challenge printed textbook summaries by cross-examining conflicting primary letters from the same decade. questionPhrase: people who sit for long periods

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ sự chậm trễ lịch tàu mùa đông, là hậu quả xảy ra.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (have little effect on + clause → exert minimal sway over + N): "has little effect on how voters decide" ↔ "exerts minimal sway over electoral choices".

questionPhrase: are far more likely to reoffend
context: Probation statistics across regional court districts demonstrate that individuals released from custody without stable rental accommodation face a substantially higher probability of returning to crime within twelve months. Linking housing vouchers directly to post-release mentoring clinics breaks this costly cycle and eases overcrowding in local jails.

target.text: face a substantially higher probability of returning to crime

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ chỗ ở thuê ổn định, là yếu tố bảo vệ.
Chỉ trung tâm cố vấn sau khi ra tù, là dịch vụ hỗ trợ.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (be far more likely to V → face a substantially higher probability of V-ing): "are far more likely to reoffend" ↔ "face a substantially higher probability of returning to crime".

context: Sociological interviews with urban families participating in weekend allotment gardening show that collaborating on practical seasonal chores frequently deepens mutual attachment among grandparents and grandchildren. Working side by side to harvest beans or repair trellises sparks relaxed conversations that rarely arise during formal holiday dinners.

target.text: frequently deepens mutual attachment among

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ việc làm vườn cuối tuần, là hoạt động gắn kết.
Chỉ ông bà và cháu, là các thành viên tham gia.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (tend to + V → frequently + V): "tends to strengthen bonds between" ↔ "frequently deepens mutual attachment among".

context: Long before direct weekend rail links opened the valley to younger outdoor cyclists, the cluster of nearby highland spa towns historically drew the majority of its visitors from retired domestic travellers seeking mineral baths. Local hotels have since diversified their amenities to serve both convalescent guests and trail runners.

target.text: historically drew the majority of its visitors from

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ thị trấn suối khoáng vùng cao lân cận, là địa điểm du lịch.
Chỉ tuyến tàu thẳng cuối tuần, là yếu tố thu hút nhóm khách mới.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (bị động was once visited by → chủ động historically drew... from): "was once visited mainly by" ↔ "historically drew the majority of its visitors from".

questionPhrase: costs less to produce per calorie
context: Agronomic life-cycle comparisons consistently demonstrate that cultivating dried field legumes such as chickpeas and lentils requires lower production outlay for each unit of food energy than raising grain-fed beef cattle. Because pulse crops naturally fix atmospheric nitrogen in root nodules, they also cut synthetic fertiliser expenses for farmers.

target.text: requires lower production outlay for each unit of food energy

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ các loại đậu hạt khô, là thực phẩm ví dụ.
Chỉ bò thịt nuôi ngũ cốc, là nhóm tốn chi phí hơn.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (cost less to V → require lower outlay for N): "costs less to produce per calorie" ↔ "requires lower production outlay for each unit of food energy".

context: When the municipal gallery unveiled its daring glass atrium attached to a baroque stone wing, the stark contrast initially did not gain the approval of reviewers writing for architectural journals. Within months, however, record first-year attendance and bright public reading lounges turned the extension into a beloved civic landmark.

target.text: did not gain the approval of reviewers

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ sảnh kính táo bạo, là hạng mục kiến trúc gây tranh cãi.
Chỉ lượng khách năm đầu kỷ lục, thể hiện công chúng ủng hộ.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (fail to V → did not gain + N): "failed to win over critics" ↔ "did not gain the approval of reviewers".

questionPhrase: depends heavily on teamwork rather than
context: Coaches introducing beginners to competitive coastal rowing emphasise that boat velocity hinges far more on collective coordination than on individual sprint speed or raw upper-body strength. Even a crew of lighter athletes can outpace stronger rivals when every oar enters and leaves choppy swells in seamless rhythm.

target.text: hinges far more on collective coordination than on

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ tốc độ bứt tốc cá nhân, là yếu tố đối lập.
Chỉ môn chèo thuyền ven biển, là môn thể thao ví dụ.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (depend heavily on X rather than Y → hinge far more on X than on Y): "depends heavily on teamwork rather than" ↔ "hinges far more on collective coordination than on".

context: Hydrophone tracking along heavily trafficked straits suggests that migrating pods of baleen whales have acquired the ability to steer clear of busy shipping channels whenever vessels slow below ten knots. Deploying real-time acoustic warning buoys alerts bridge crews to nearby whale calls and dramatically lowers collision risks.

target.text: have acquired the ability to steer clear of

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ tuyến hàng hải đông đúc, là khu vực nguy hiểm.
Chỉ phao phát tín hiệu âm thanh cảnh báo, là thiết bị hỗ trợ.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (learn to V → acquire the ability to V): "have learned to navigate around" ↔ "have acquired the ability to steer clear of".

context: Unlike royal courts and wealthy merchant guilds, itinerant medieval tinsmiths and seasonal charcoal burners produced virtually zero surviving documents detailing their daily routines. Consequently, social historians reconstruct how ordinary rural craftspeople lived by studying tool marks and broken cookware recovered from excavated village rubbish pits.

target.text: produced virtually zero surviving documents

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ thợ thiếc lưu động thời trung cổ, là nhóm người nghiên cứu.
Chỉ hố rác làng cổ được khai quật, là nguồn chứng cứ khảo cổ.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (leave almost no + N → produce virtually zero + N): "left almost no written trace" ↔ "produced virtually zero surviving documents".

questionPhrase: are more willing to admit mistakes
context: Hospital safety audits reveal that surgical theatre teams led by approachable senior consultants show greater readiness to acknowledge errors before minor slips escalate into patient harm. Replacing punitive blame cultures with structured no-fault incident reviews consistently encourages junior nurses to speak up immediately when equipment checks look irregular.

target.text: show greater readiness to acknowledge errors

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ đội ngũ phòng mổ, là nhóm chuyên môn được khảo sát.
Chỉ văn hóa đổ lỗi trừng phạt, là yếu tố cản trở.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (be more willing to V → show greater readiness to V): "are more willing to admit mistakes" ↔ "show greater readiness to acknowledge errors".

questionPhrase: takes roughly eight minutes to reach
context: Space-weather forecasters continuously monitor solar flare eruptions because intense bursts of electromagnetic light require approximately eight minutes to travel to Earth, leaving minimal lead time before high-frequency polar aviation radios experience temporary static. Slower streams of charged plasma arrive days later, giving power-grid operators time to protect transformers.

target.text: require approximately eight minutes to travel to

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ đợt bùng phát bão Mặt Trời, là nguồn bức xạ.
Chỉ hệ thống liên lạc hàng không vùng cực, là hệ thống chịu ảnh hưởng.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (take + time + to reach → require + time + to travel to): "takes roughly eight minutes to reach" ↔ "requires approximately eight minutes to travel to".

context: Because electricity output from solar panels and wind farms fluctuates substantially according to atmospheric conditions, national energy planners increasingly combine variable renewables with steady baseload sources such as geothermal steam wells. Sharing surplus power across interconnected regional grids further smooths local cloud cover and calm spells.

target.text: fluctuates substantially according to atmospheric conditions

decoys.whyVi: Chỉ giếng hơi địa nhiệt, là nguồn điện ổn định đối lập.
Chỉ lưới điện liên kết khu vực, là giải pháp cân bằng.

explanationVi: L3 đổi cấu trúc (vary widely depending on → fluctuate substantially according to): "varies widely depending on weather" ↔ "fluctuates substantially according to atmospheric conditions".
